checks.detail: Exact local finite section derivative includes 1/sigma; sigma is the actual residual standard deviation and equals sqrt(1-rho^2) for the selected unit nonparallel pair.
Actual conditional residual event is proved pointwise equal to the symmetric bisector-frame pair event, retaining every inactive inequality as <=.
Archived actual frame change and Gaussian density rotation are applied without whole-family independence; their hypotheses concern only the selected unit nonparallel pair.
Swapping selected faces changes the difference frame and its level by the same sign, so the actual pair section point and physical density remain equal.
Parallel selected normals yield zero residual normals; nonzero affine slack makes their actual finite coordinate derivative zero on both sides; full pair symmetry is derived, not assumed.
Nonnegativity follows the actual finite section formula or zero/outside cases, rather than an assumed sign of an abstract surface functional.

normalization: Euclidean orthogonal chart volume and Euclidean-volume polar angular measure; no equality to diameter-normalized raw Mathlib Hausdorff measure asserted.
